ASUS Picasso camera lens actuators
=================================

Picasso actuators use the Qualcomm camera actuator interface, but their
power rails are owned and sequenced by the associated sensor or OIS. The
actuator driver must only initialize/release its I2C interface, without
constructing a separate regulator power sequence.

Required property:
- compatible: "asus,picasso-actuator", "qcom,actuator"

The remaining properties follow the Qualcomm camera actuator interface.
This compatible must not be used for actuators with independently managed
power rails.
